scope: Complete unmodified original 0x10015e420 oriented-box/six-plane test, with explicit RTE or RTZ/FTZ/DAZ ambient MXCSR. Half-axis normalization, ordered radius/center dot products, strict tangent rejection, degenerate axes and unordered comparisons checked. 77 serialized terrain bounds across 31 maps supply explicit OBB snapshots. Original TerrainBarn plane production, enabled object transforms, distance sorting, per-bin AABB/LOD/job dispatch, loaders and viewport culling remain unverified.
